text: {"title":"HTTP Responses by Status Class and Service","timeRange":{"from":"now-1h","to":"now"},"refreshIntervalMs":15000,"panels":[{"id":"status-class-share","title":"Response share by HTTP status class","description":"Compute the percentage share of all HTTP responses grouped by status class (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx), counting requests per class.","viz":"donut","format":"percent","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN status >= 200 AND status < 300 THEN '2xx' WHEN status >= 300 AND status < 400 THEN '3xx' WHEN status >= 400 AND status < 500 THEN '4xx' WHEN status >= 500 AND status < 600 THEN '5xx' ELSE 'other' END AS status_class, count(*) * 100.0 / sum(count(*)) OVER () AS share_pct FROM http_requests GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"},"options":{"decimals":1,"legend":"right"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}},{"id":"requests-per-service","title":"Requests per service","description":"Count the total number of HTTP requests handled by each service, shown as one bar per service.","viz":"bar","format":"number","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT service, count(*) AS requests FROM http_requests GROUP BY service ORDER BY requests DESC"},"options":{"compact":true,"legend":"none","yAxis":{"label":"requests"}},"layout":{"x":6,"y":0,"w":6,"h":4}}]}
